reason: The commit extends existing HTML5 parsing behavior so that a DIV within a DL is handled by the definition-list parser. It does not add an entry point, alter the public API protocol, require new initialization or configuration, or impose new input constraints. Existing harnesses already feed arbitrary markup through tidyParseBuffer, tidyParseString, and tidyParseFile, with several continuing through tidyCleanAndRepair and tidyRunDiagnostics, so inputs containing DL/DIV structures can exercise the changed high-level parsing path without harness changes.
evidence: TY_(ParseDefList) now accepts a node when nodeIsDIV(node) && TY_(IsHTML5Mode)(doc), in addition to DT and DD.
TY_(ParseBlock) now redirects a DIV whose parent is a DL in HTML5 mode to TY_(ParseDefList)(doc, element, mode).
tidy_fuzzer passes arbitrary bytes to tidyParseBuffer and then invokes tidyCleanAndRepair and tidyRunDiagnostics.
tidy_parse_string_fuzzer and tidy_xml_fuzzer pass arbitrary null-terminated input to tidyParseString; tidy_parse_file_fuzzer and tidy_general_fuzzer also exercise file parsing.
No changed function signature, public entry point, initialization sequence, configuration requirement, or input format appears in the diff.
recommended_action: Keep the existing harnesses unchanged; optionally add DL/DIV examples to the fuzz corpus or dictionary, but this is a coverage enhancement rather than required harness maintenance.
